data.change_summary: Added an explicit stage-trace note hook inside the engine and used it to record deterministic intermediate notes for traced chemistry, dissolved-oxygen, and daily biofilter maturity stages. Moved the daily biofilter follow-up event emission into the traced stage so `events_generated` is fully attributed, made `Verbosity::Off` skip tick construction/storage/sink writes entirely, updated the tracing docs to match that contract, and expanded integration coverage for trace notes, post-stage event attribution, summary-note suppression, and off-mode sink behavior.

steps.description: Inspected the current engine/tracing flow and existing tracing coverage to confirm the three remediation gaps around trace notes, event attribution, and off-mode behavior.

Patched the engine tracing path to support explicit per-stage note collection, to attribute daily biofilter events inside the traced stage, and to avoid creating or finishing ticks when tracer verbosity is `Off`.

Extended integration tests to assert non-empty trace notes for a deterministic daily biofilter fixture, exact post-stage event attribution for that stage, and zero retained/emitted output when tracing is configured with `Verbosity::Off`.
Formatted the code and ran targeted plus full-package validation to confirm the fixes and guard against regressions.

validation_evidence: `cargo test -p tank_core` passed the full `tank_core` test suite, including the updated tracing integration tests.
